title: The Monkey's Paw, Part 1
hook: Some wishes should never be made.

lines.vo: Some wishes should never be made.
lines.caption: Some wishes should never be made.

lines.vo: A cold, wet night. The Whites sat by the fire.
lines.caption: A cold, wet night.

lines.vo: Then came a knock at the door.
lines.caption: Then came a knock at the door.

lines.vo: He took a shrivelled monkey's paw from his pocket.
lines.caption: He took a shrivelled monkey's paw.

lines.vo: Three men, he said, could each have three wishes.
lines.caption: Three men. Three wishes each.

lines.vo: Then he threw it on the fire.
lines.caption: Then he threw it on the fire.
